newsitem.title: USA: Judge reported injured in courthouse bombingh.
newsitem.headline: Judge reported injured in courthouse bombingh.

text.p: A man threw a Molotov cocktail in a courtroom at the Champaign County courthouse Tuesday, slightly injuring a judge, officials said.
Police and officials at the courthouse said one other person may have been injured in the indicent which occurred during a trial.
Witnesses said smoke could be seen coming from the building.
Broadcast reports said the incident happened as jury selection was under way in a civil trial involving a medical matter.
Witnesses said the man entered the room with a bottle containing a liquid and a wick, lit it and tossed it at the bench.
Urbana, along with neighbouring Champaign, is the site of the University of Illinois, about 200 miles south of Chicago.
